title: 微软项目团队怎样写共同遵守的工作宣言
topic: 微软项目团队怎样写共同遵守的工作宣言

source.title: Team Manifesto - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: ISE teams work with a new development team in each customer engagement which requires a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer before starting an engagement.
Completion of this phase of ice-breakers and discussions about the standards takes time, but is required to start increasing the learning curve of the new team.

A team manifesto is a light-weight one page agile document among team members which summarizes the basic principles and values of the team and aiming to provide a consensus about technical expectations from each team member in order to deliver high quality output at the end of each engagement.

It aims to reduce the time on setting the right expectations without arranging longer "team document reading" meetings and provide a consensus among team members to answer the question - "How does the new team develop the software?" - by covering all engineering fundamentals and excellence topics such as release process, clean coding, testing.
Another main goal of writing the manifesto is to start a conversation during the "manifesto building session" to detect any differences of opinion around how the team should work.
It also serves in the same way when a new team member joins to the team. New joiners can quickly get up to speed on the agreed standards.
translations: ISE团队在每个客户合作中与一个新的开发团队一起工作，这需要在开始合作前有一个介绍和知识转移的阶段。
完成破冰活动并讨论团队标准需要时间，但这有助于新团队逐步上手。
团队宣言是一份由团队成员共同使用的一页轻量级敏捷文档，总结团队的基本原则和价值观，并帮助大家就每位成员的技术职责达成共识，从而在每次客户合作结束时交付高质量成果。
撰写宣言的目的之一，是通过“宣言共创会议”展开讨论，发现团队对工作方式的不同看法。它也能帮助新成员快速了解团队已经达成一致的标准。
撰写宣言的另一个主要目标是在'宣言构建会议'期间开始对话，以发现团队工作方式方面的任何意见分歧。
当新成员加入团队时，这份宣言也能发挥同样的作用。新人可以迅速了解团队约定的标准。
fullTextParagraphs: ISE teams work with a new development team in each customer engagement which requires a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer before starting an engagement.
Completion of this phase of ice-breakers and discussions about the standards takes time, but is required to start increasing the learning curve of the new team.

A team manifesto is a light-weight one page agile document among team members which summarizes the basic principles and values of the team and aiming to provide a consensus about technical expectations from each team member in order to deliver high quality output at the end of each engagement.

It aims to reduce the time on setting the right expectations without arranging longer "team document reading" meetings and provide a consensus among team members to answer the question - "How does the new team develop the software?" - by covering all engineering fundamentals and excellence topics such as release process, clean coding, testing.
Another main goal of writing the manifesto is to start a conversation during the "manifesto building session" to detect any differences of opinion around how the team should work.
It also serves in the same way when a new team member joins to the team. New joiners can quickly get up to speed on the agreed standards.
It can be said that the best time to start building it is at the very early phase of the engagement when teams meet with each other for swarming or during the preparation phase.

It is recommended to keep team manifesto as simple as possible, so preferably, one-page simple document which doesn't include any references or links is a nice format for it. If there is a need for providing knowledge on certain topics, the way to do is delivering brown-bag sessions, technical katas, team practices, documentations and others later on.
A few important points about the team manifesto
The team manifesto is built by the development team itself
It should cover all required technical engineering points for the excellence as well as behavioral agility mindset items that the team finds relevant
It aims to give a common understanding about the desired expertise, practices and/or mindset within the team
Based on the needs of the team and retrospective results, it can be modified during the engagement.
In ISE, we aim for quality over quantity, and well-crafted software as well as to a comfortable/transparent environment where each team member can reach their highest potential.

The difference between the team manifesto and other team documents is that it is used to give a short summary of expectations around the technical way of working and supported mindset in the team, before code-with sprints starts.
Below, you can find some including, but not limited, topics many teams touch during engagements,

Generally team sessions are enough for building a manifesto and having a consensus around it, and if there is a need for improving it in a structured way, there are many blogs and tools online, any retrospective tool can be used.

notes.example: The onboarding process includes a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer to ensure new hires understand our company culture.

notes.explain: 轻量级的一页式敏捷文档，概述团队基本价值观和技术期望，帮助团队达成共识

scenario.title: Agree on engineering expectations before a project starts
english: A new engineering team is beginning a customer engagement. Team members have different expectations for code review, testing, and release practices.
You suggest writing a one-page team manifesto together so everyone can agree on the technical expectations before work begins.
The team can update the document as it learns what works during the engagement.
chinese: 一个工程团队刚开始客户项目，成员对代码评审、测试和发布流程的预期不一致。
你建议大家共同写一页团队宣言，在开始工作前对齐技术协作标准。
项目过程中，团队还可以根据实际情况更新这份文件。

firstAttempt.prompt: 产品团队对上线前的测试范围和发布沟通方式各有理解。请用英文建议在项目开始时一起写下共同约定，并说明可以在合作中更新。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we write down our testing and release expectations together before the project gets underway? We can revisit the agreement as we learn what the team needs.
firstAttempt.rationale: 团队共同写下具体工作约定，并在合作中根据新经验回看和调整。

words.example: Our team maintains regular customer engagement throughout the project lifecycle.
words.translation: 我们的团队在整个项目生命周期中保持与客户的持续互动。
words.note: 指企业与客户之间的互动关系，也可指具体的项目合作

words.example: The new software has a steep learning curve, so we allocated extra training time.
words.translation: 这个新软件的学习曲线很陡峭，所以我们分配了额外的培训时间。
words.note: 描述掌握新技能所需的时间和难度，曲线越陡表示学习难度越大

words.example: Our team prefers creating concise agile documents rather than extensive specifications.
words.translation: 我们团队倾向于创建简洁的敏捷文档，而不是冗长的规范文档。
words.note: 敏捷开发中使用的简洁、实用的文档，强调可操作性和及时更新

words.example: The onboarding process sets clear technical expectations for all developers.
words.translation: 入职流程为所有开发者设定明确的技术期望。
words.note: 对团队成员在技术实现方面应达到的标准和要求

words.example: Before working on advanced features, all engineers must master the engineering fundamentals.
words.translation: 在处理高级功能之前，所有工程师必须掌握工程基础知识。
words.note: 指软件开发的基本原则、方法和最佳实践

words.example: The new hire was able to quickly get up to speed with our development workflow.
words.translation: 新员工能够快速了解我们的开发工作流程。
words.note: 指迅速熟悉新环境、新项目或新技术的状态

structure.original: ISE teams work with a new development team in each customer engagement which requires a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer before starting an engagement.
analysis: 主语是'ISE teams'，谓语是'work with'，宾语是'a new development team'
状语'in each customer engagement'修饰谓语动词，表示工作发生的场景
定语从句'which requires...'修饰'customer engagement'，说明每个客户合作都需要介绍和知识转移阶段
structure.transfer: Sales representatives collaborate with a new marketing team in every product launch which necessitates a period of orientation & information exchange before commencing the campaign.

rewrite.bad: Li, draft the manifesto by Friday. I’ll decide what everyone’s expectations should be.
rewrite.good: Could we write a one-page team manifesto together before development starts? Let’s agree on release, testing, and coding expectations, then update it as we learn.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否在开发开始前一起写一页团队宣言？先对齐发布、测试和代码规范，再根据实际经验更新。
rewrite.pattern: Could we create [a shared working agreement] before [the project starts] and update it as [the team learns]?

cloze.prompt: Could we write ___ our testing and release expectations together?

cloze.prompt: Let’s agree on this before the project gets ___.
cloze.why: get underway 表示项目开始推进。

cloze.prompt: We can ___ the agreement as we learn what the team needs.
cloze.why: revisit the agreement 表示后续回看并根据需要调整。

dictation.text: The marketing team needs to create a team manifesto during the introduction phase of a new product launch project.
Different team members have varying priorities: some focus on speed, others on quality, and some on budget constraints.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否一起写下测试和发布方面的共同约定？
translationPractice.answer: Could we write down our testing and release expectations together?
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“write down our testing and release expectations”在把测试和发布的共同预期写下来时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否在项目开始前写下共同约定？
translationPractice.answer: Could we write down our expectations before the project gets underway?
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“before the project gets underway”在在项目正式开始之前时的用法。

choice.prompt: 新项目团队对发布、测试和代码规范的理解不一致。请用英文建议在开发开始前共同写一页团队约定，并邀请成员补充。
options: Li, draft the manifesto by Friday. I’ll decide what everyone’s expectations should be.
Could we create a one-page team manifesto together before development starts? We can agree on release, testing, and coding expectations, then update it as the team learns.
Could you share a specific example and explain what effect it had on the team?
choice.why: 团队约定应由团队共同建立，把具体工作标准放在一页内，后续也能根据合作情况调整。

output.prompt: 新产品发布前，支持团队担心升级后客户问题由谁跟进，工程团队也不确定多久同步一次。请用英文建议在发布前写下交接和升级约定，并在首周后根据实际情况更新。
output.sample: Could we write down our handoff and escalation expectations before the launch? We can revisit the agreement after the first week and update it based on what the teams need.
